knowledge.purpose: Shell block: pins the primary destinations — one per real destination, at most five, never padded to fill the bar — to the BOTTOM edge of the screen; every destination carries an icon AND a label. It stays in place while scrolling and reserves its own height in the flow, so it never covers the page's last band.
useCases: Primary navigation in a narrow-screen-first tool (the bottom-bar shell)
Switching sections in a one-handed field/mobile app
The form the persistent left rail TURNS INTO on a narrow screen
antiPatterns: Adding a sixth destination — the schema stops at 5; six destinations are a menu, not a bar
Dropping the label and leaving the icon alone — an icon's meaning is a learned assumption; the label declares it
Using it as a footer — a footer is read and scrolls, a bottom bar navigates and stays fixed
Authoring `account` in a receipt or pattern — the runner injects the real visitor; a hand-written one is a fake session
knowledge.implementation:
Further anti-patterns:
- Repeating the same destination in the top bar — a destination in two places makes it unclear which is right

Account target: with `account` injected, the bar still holds at most 5 targets and the account is always the last. An item routing to `account.profileHref` (compared as routes: trailing slash, query and hash ignored) is removed and its label reused for the account target and the sheet's Profile entry (precedence for that entry: folded tab label, then account.profileLabel, then "Profile"); otherwise, a full bar gives its 5th slot to the account. Tapping opens a bottom sheet (scrim, 44px targets, safe-area padding) with name + email, Profile, links and Sign out — a sheet rather than a jump to the profile page, so sign-out is never hidden behind a page the app may not have. While a fixed bar is mounted it publishes `--pw-bottom-bar-height: <height>px` and `data-pw-bottom-bar-height` on the document root so host overlays can sit above it. Actions: payload.action {type: "auth:signIn" | "auth:signOut"}.

jsonSchema.description: Navigation destinations: [{label, href?, icon?}] — 3 to 5, each icon + label.
href of the currently active destination — the matching item gets aria-current="page".
fixed: pinned to the viewport bottom (the real shell behaviour). static: stays in flow — for an editor/preview canvas.
Bar height (px). The space reserved in flow is the same value.
Accessible name of the nav element.

props.name: account
props.type: {state: 'signed-in' | 'signed-out', name?, email?, avatarSrc?, profileHref?, profileLabel?, links?: [{label, href}], signInLabel?, signOutLabel?}

profileHref.description: App route of the profile page, already rewritten by the runner.

profileLabel.description: Localised label of the Profile menu entry. Default "Profile"; a folded bottom-bar tab keeps its own label.

links.description: Extra account-menu entries, listed after Profile.

jsonSchema.description: The published app's visitor, INJECTED BY THE RUNNER — do not author it. Rendered as the LAST target (avatar + label; "Sign in" when signed out) and opens a bottom sheet with profile, links and sign out. A destination whose href equals profileHref (trailing slash / query ignored) is folded into it, keeping its label; otherwise the account takes the 5th slot.
